summary: Oklo Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market equity distribution program of up to $1,000,000,000 in Class A common stock under an Equity Distribution Agreement dated September 11, 2026, with a syndicate of sales agents including Goldman Sachs, BofA, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Barclays, Cantor Fitzgerald, Guggenheim, Canaccord Genuity and B. Riley. Commissions run up to 1.5% of gross proceeds; no escrow. Future forward sale agreements, including range forwards, are contemplated but not executed. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any forward-sale overhang.
